meta.review_notes: Re-analysis based on April 2020 privacy policy (Wayback Machine capture, ~45k chars). This version differs from previously analyzed policy attributed to Eternal Limited. Prior unsupported quotes were removed or corrected. Camera and microphone hardware access is not explicitly addressed in this policy version.

app.name: Zomato: Food Delivery & Dining
app.description: Discover restaurants, read reviews, and order food for delivery or dining out.

verdict.one_liner: Zomato collects your location, device details, and usage activity, and may share data with affiliates and advertisers. Its policy says continued use automatically accepts future changes.
verdict.summary: Zomato is a food delivery and restaurant discovery app. Based on its April 2020 privacy policy, it collects personal information including your name, email, phone number, and payment card details. It may collect real-time GPS location, device identifiers, and detailed usage logs including searches and pages viewed. The policy states that data may be shared with subsidiaries, affiliates, contractors, advertisers, and service providers. Continued use of the app is deemed acceptance of any future policy changes. The policy does not clearly explain camera or microphone hardware access.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Zomato collects and shares a notable amount of personal data, including your location, device identifiers, and activity logs. Payment card details may be stored for future transactions. The policy automatically binds you to future changes without advance notice.

red.title: App may access files and metadata stored on your device
red.plain_english: Zomato states that its applications may access metadata and other information associated with files stored on your mobile device, including photographs, audio and video clips, and address book information.
red.policy_excerpt: Stored information and files: Our applications also may access metadata and other information associated with other files stored on your mobile device. This may include, for example, photographs, audio and video clips, personal contacts and address book information.

red.title: Payment card information may be stored and shared with processors
red.plain_english: If you make a purchase, Zomato may collect and store your credit or payment card details, and share them with third-party payment service providers. Those providers may also store your card information for future transactions.
red.policy_excerpt: If you make reservations or purchases through our Services, we may collect and store information about you to process your requests and automatically complete forms for future transactions, including (but not limited to) your phone number, address, email, billing information and credit or payment card information. This information may be shared with third-parties which assist in processing and fulfilling your requests, including PCI compliant payment gateway processors.

red.title: Policy changes are accepted automatically if you keep using the app
red.plain_english: Zomato says its privacy policy may change from time to time, and your continued use of the Services after any change is deemed acceptance of those changes.
red.policy_excerpt: This policy may change from time to time, your continued use of Zomato's Services after it makes any change is deemed to be acceptance of those changes, so please check the policy periodically for updates.

red.title: Mobile device advertising identifiers cannot be deleted
red.plain_english: Zomato states that unlike cookies, the mobile device IDs it uses to recognize you and track your use of its applications cannot be deleted.
red.policy_excerpt: Unlike cookies, mobile device IDs cannot be deleted.

red.title: Your data may be combined with information from third parties
red.plain_english: Zomato says it may obtain information about you from third parties such as partners, marketers, third-party websites, and researchers, and combine that information with data it collects from or about you.
red.policy_excerpt: We may also obtain information about you from third parties such as partners, marketers, third-party websites, and researchers, and combine that information with information which we collect from or about you.

red.title: Data is shared with subsidiaries and affiliates
red.plain_english: Zomato may disclose your personal information to its subsidiaries and affiliates, which are entities under common ownership or control of its ultimate parent company, Zomato Media Private Limited.
red.policy_excerpt: To our subsidiaries and affiliates, which are entities under common ownership or control of our ultimate parent company Zomato Media Private Limited.

green.title: Payment processors are PCI compliant
green.plain_english: Zomato states that the third-party payment gateway processors it uses are validated as compliant with payment card industry standards.
green.policy_excerpt: The third party service providers with respect to payment gateway and payment processing are all validated as compliant with the payment card industry standard (generally referred to as PCI compliant service providers).

green.title: You can request account deletion
green.plain_english: Zomato says you can request to permanently delete your account by contacting its Data Protection Officer.
green.policy_excerpt: If you would like to review, change or delete personal information we have collected from you, or permanently delete your account, please use the "Contact Us" link at the bottom of every page (also located here), or contact the Zomato Data Protection Officer (DPO).

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The April 2020 privacy policy does not explicitly address camera or microphone hardware access. It mentions that users may upload photographs and videos as part of their content.
categories.detail: The policy states that users may provide photographs and videos through the Services, such as reviews and profile pictures, but does not explicitly discuss camera or microphone hardware access.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your content: Information you provide through our Services, including your reviews, photographs, comments, lists, followers, the users you follow, current and prior restaurant reservation details, food ordering details and history, favorite restaurants, special restaurant requests, contact information of people you add to, or notify of, your restaurant reservations through our Services, names, and other information you provide on our Services, and other information in your account profile.
concerns: Policy does not clearly explain if or when the app accesses camera or microphone hardware

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Zomato may collect and process real-time GPS location from your mobile device to customize services with location-based information and features.
categories.detail: The policy states that applications collect real-time location information from your device as permitted by you, including latitude, longitude, and altitude. This is used to customize services with location-based information and features, such as showing nearby restaurants.
categories.policy_excerpt: Location information: Our applications collect real-time information about the location of your device, as permitted by you. ... we may collect and process information about your mobile device's GPS location (including the latitude, longitude or altitude of your mobile device) and the time the location information is recorded to customize the Services with location-based information and features
concerns: Location data may be associated with device ID and other information

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: You may provide a friend's contact information to invite them to join Zomato. The app may also access metadata associated with files on your device, which may include personal contacts.
categories.detail: The policy states that you can request friends to join by providing their contact information, which is used only to process the request. Additionally, the application may access metadata and other information associated with files stored on your mobile device, which may include personal contacts and address book information.
categories.policy_excerpt: You have the option to request your friends to join the Services by providing their contact information. If you request a friend to join and connect with you on the Services, we will only use your friend's contact information to process your request.
concerns: Application may access contact metadata from device files

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Zomato's applications may access metadata and other information associated with files stored on your mobile device, including photographs, audio, video clips, and contacts.
categories.detail: The policy states that applications may access metadata and other information associated with files stored on your mobile device, such as photographs, audio and video clips, personal contacts, and address book information.
categories.policy_excerpt: Stored information and files: Our applications also may access metadata and other information associated with other files stored on your mobile device. This may include, for example, photographs, audio and video clips, personal contacts and address book information.
concerns: Broad file and metadata access on device

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Zomato may share your personal information with subsidiaries, affiliates, contractors, advertisers, service providers, and third parties for marketing if you consent. Data may also be transferred in a merger or sale.
categories.detail: The policy discloses sharing with subsidiaries and affiliates, contractors and service providers, third parties for marketing with consent, buyers in corporate transactions, and for legal purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: To our subsidiaries and affiliates, which are entities under common ownership or control of our ultimate parent company Zomato Media Private Limited. To contractors, advertisers/service providers and other third-parties whom we use to support our business (e.g. dinner reservations and food delivery) and who are bound by contractual obligations to keep personal information confidential and use it only for the purposes for which we disclose it to them. To a buyer or other successor in the event of a merger, divestiture, restructuring, reorganization, dissolution or other sale or transfer of some or all of Zomato's assets... To third-parties to market their products or services to you if you have consented to receive the promotional updates.
concerns: Data shared with multiple categories of third parties
Corporate transactions may transfer data to new owners

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Zomato requires personal details to create an account and may combine your data with information from third-party partners, marketers, and researchers.
categories.detail: The policy states that account information collected includes your full name, email address, postal code, password, gender, mobile phone number, and website. It also says Zomato may obtain information about you from third parties and combine it with data it collects.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your account information: Your full name, email address, postal code, password and other information you may provide with your account, such as your gender, mobile phone number and website. ... We may also obtain information about you from third parties such as partners, marketers, third-party websites, and researchers, and combine that information with information which we collect from or about you.
concerns: Identity data may be combined with third-party information

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Zomato uses cookies, pixel tags, web beacons, and mobile device IDs to collect information about your use of the Services and third-party websites, and may use this to show you targeted advertisements.
categories.detail: The policy states that Zomato and its partners use cookies, pixel tags, web beacons, mobile device IDs, and similar technologies to collect and store information about your use of the Services and third-party websites. It also says Zomato may use collected information to display advertisements to advertisers' target audiences.
categories.policy_excerpt: We, and third parties with whom we partner, may use cookies, pixel tags, web beacons, mobile device IDs, "flash cookies" and similar files or technologies to collect and store information in respect to your use of the Services and third party websites. ... We may use the information we have collected from you to enable us to display advertisements to our advertisers'/service providers' target audiences.
concerns: Mobile device IDs used for tracking and cannot be deleted

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Zomato says its Services are not intended for users under 18 and that it does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under that age.
categories.detail: The policy states that the Services are not intended for users under the age of 18 unless permitted under local laws, and that Zomato does not knowingly collect personal information from users under that age.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Services are not intended for users under the age of 18, unless permitted under applicable local laws (Permissible Age). We do not knowingly collect any personal information from users or market to or solicit information from anyone under the Permissible Age.
concerns: No detailed age verification mechanism described

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Zomato logs your searches, pages viewed, clicks, time spent, IP address, and other usage details for analytics and advertising.
categories.detail: The policy states that Zomato collects details about your use of its Services, including traffic data, location data, logs, search queries, pages viewed, number of clicks, features used, and how long you visited. This information is used to understand users, improve content, display relevant advertising, and generate reports.
categories.policy_excerpt: Usage information: Details of your use of our Services, including traffic data, location data, logs and other communication data and the resources that you access and use on or through our Services. ... Your activity on the Services: Information about your activity on the Services, such as your search queries, comments, domain names, search results selected, number of clicks, pages viewed and the order of those pages, how long you visited our Services, the date and time you used the Services, error logs, and other similar information.
concerns: Extensive activity logging for analytics and ads
IP address collected and may be used for general location inference

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Zomato collects your device type, operating system, browser type, IP address, unique device identifiers, and mobile network information. It states that mobile device IDs cannot be deleted.
categories.detail: The policy states that Zomato collects computer and device information including IP address, operating systems, browser type, device type, unique device identifier, mobile network information, and the device's telephone number. It also notes that unlike cookies, mobile device IDs cannot be deleted.
categories.policy_excerpt: Computer and device information: Information about your computer, Internet connection and mobile device, including your IP address, operating systems, platforms, browser type, other browsing information (connection, speed, connection type etc.), device type, device's unique device identifier, mobile network information and the device's telephone number. ... Unlike cookies, mobile device IDs cannot be deleted.
concerns: Mobile device IDs cannot be deleted by users
Device information collected automatically even without registration

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Zomato does not collect health or biometric data from regular users according to this policy.
categories.detail: The April 2020 privacy policy does not mention collection of health or biometric data for regular users.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Zomato may collect and store your billing and payment card information when you make a purchase, and shares it with third-party payment processors.
categories.detail: The policy states that when you make reservations or purchases, Zomato may collect and store your billing information and credit or payment card details. This information may be shared with third parties that assist in processing and fulfilling requests, including PCI compliant payment gateway processors.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you make reservations or purchases through our Services, we may collect and store information about you to process your requests and automatically complete forms for future transactions, including (but not limited to) your phone number, address, email, billing information and credit or payment card information. This information may be shared with third-parties which assist in processing and fulfilling your requests, including PCI compliant payment gateway processors.
concerns: Payment card information stored and shared with third parties

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request deletion of your account, but Zomato may retain some information for legal purposes or de-identify it instead of deleting it.
categories.detail: The policy states that you can close your account and request deletion. Public posts may be removed or dissociated from your profile, but information may be retained for purposes authorized under the privacy policy, and thereafter either deleted or de-identified.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can close your account by visiting your profile settings page on our website. We will remove your public posts from view and/or dissociate them from your account profile, but we may retain information about you for the purposes authorized under this Privacy Policy unless prohibited by law. Thereafter, we will either delete your personal information or de-identify it so that it is anonymous and not attributed to your identity.
concerns: Data may be retained for legal purposes after deletion request
May be de-identified rather than fully deleted

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Zomato can change its privacy policy at any time, and your continued use of the app means you automatically accept the new terms.
categories.detail: The policy states that it may change from time to time and that continued use after any change is deemed acceptance of those changes, with no requirement for advance notice or active re-consent.
categories.policy_excerpt: This policy may change from time to time, your continued use of Zomato's Services after it makes any change is deemed to be acceptance of those changes, so please check the policy periodically for updates.
concerns: No advance notice or active consent required for policy changes
